name: design-product
job: Design a product blueprint (app, game, SaaS, or similar) with one deep core concept and build-ready acceptance criteria.

inScope: Framing product promise, users, surfaces, non-goals, and success criteria
Choosing shape and opening only the matching reference pack
Synthesizing one blueprint with critical flows, states, and risks
Handing off with testable acceptance criteria and tradeoff rollback

inputs: Shape context (app, game, SaaS, marketing automation, etc.)
outputs: Product design blueprint with structure and critical flows
Build-ready acceptance criteria with rollback conditions
failureSemantics: A design that spreads across many half-concepts instead of one deep core concept, or that lacks build-ready acceptance criteria, is incomplete; quality tradeoffs must name the sacrificed attributes and rollback conditions.

outcome.observable: A product design blueprint with one deep core concept, critical flows and states, named quality tradeoffs with rollback conditions, and acceptance criteria a builder can test.
